title: SWU card and TCGplayer price export
description: JSON Schema for the mault SWU export: the official card list (and older catalogue snapshots), and the conformed TCGplayer price files. Correct through set 9 Homeworlds (HMW, HMWP). Companion to swu-card-data-fields.md. RawPage describes the untouched API pages saved by the raw cache. Card image metadata (artFront, artBack, artThumbnail, variant icons) is permitted but out of scope. Validate a file against one of the $defs by reference, for example #/$defs/OfficialCardList.

RawPage.description: One untouched API page body: { data, meta }, as saved gzipped by the raw cache (page-NNNN.json.gz).

OfficialPrinting.description: One official SWU printing (one specific version of a card). Snapshots hold a subset of these properties, so only serialCode, cardNumber and title are required. See swu-card-data-fields.md, section Printing.

serialCode.description: Unique printing id and the join key to tcg_printings.card_id. Characters 3-4 are the variant-type digits; promo serials start with a lowercase letter code.

cardNumber.description: Collector number inside the expansion as the official API gives it; can differ from the number in the serial.

subtitle.description: Second line of the name; empty string or null when the card has none (Bases are null).

text.description: Rules text box. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line; empty string or null when the card has no text (snapshots only).

deployBox.description: Leader back-side (Leader Unit) text; non-null only on Leaders (snapshots abba1a4e and a9fa9369).

epicAction.description: Once-per-game Epic Action text: the deploy condition on Leaders, Pilot text on some Units (snapshots abba1a4e and a9fa9369).

cost.description: Resources to play the card. Null for Bases, Credit and Force tokens and a few Leaders.

power.description: Combat damage. Null for Bases, Events, Upgrades, tokens and some Leaders.

hp.description: Hit points. Null for Events, Upgrades, tokens and some Leaders.

name.description: Card type name. The set is closed in the exported data but a new set can add values (api-types.ts validates it as a plain string).
Rarity name. The set is closed in the exported data but a new set can add values (api-types.ts validates it as a plain string).

aspects.description: Aspect icons on the card (zero to three, no repeats). Strapi relation wrapper.

name.description: Aspect name. The set is closed in the exported data but a new set can add values (api-types.ts validates it as a plain string).

expansion.description: Expansion (set) the printing belongs to. Strapi relation wrapper.

code.description: Set code. The set is closed in the exported data but a new set can add values (api-types.ts validates it as a plain string).

variantTypes.description: Finish or tier of this printing. Strapi relation wrapper.

data.description: One entry for most printings; empty for some promos.

name.description: Variant name. The set is closed in the exported data but a new set can add values (api-types.ts validates it as a plain string).

variantId.description: Two-digit variant type code, also the serialCode digits 3-4 for standard-form serials.

foil.description: True for foil variants, false for non-foil, null where the API does not say (promo tiers).

keywords.description: Keyword abilities on the card (snapshot abba1a4e only). Strapi relation wrapper.

name.description: Keyword name; Fortify first appears in Homeworlds and Support in Ashes of the Empire. The set is closed in the exported data but a new set can add values (api-types.ts validates it as a plain string).

traits.description: Thematic traits printed under the art (snapshot abba1a4e only; empty on all Bases and Force tokens in the export). Fortification first appears in Homeworlds. Strapi relation wrapper.

name.description: Trait name. The set is closed in the exported data but a new set can add values (api-types.ts validates it as a plain string).

OfficialCardList.description: Official card list or catalogue snapshot: an object holding the printings array.

printings.description: Every printing, sorted by serial code.

PriceImport.description: One price_imports row: a single run of the TCGplayer conformance import. See swu-card-data-fields.md, section Price import.

id.description: Import id; every other price row carries it as import_id.

game_key.description: Game key; always swu in this export.

started_at.description: Run start, UTC timestamp without timezone suffix.

finished_at.description: Run finish, UTC timestamp without timezone suffix; null while running.

tcg_blob_sha256.description: sha256 of the pinned TCGCSV snapshot the run consumed.

official_blob_sha256.description: sha256 of the pinned official card list the run consumed.

code_commit.description: Git commit of the conform code; a -dirty suffix means uncommitted changes (inferred).

output_hash.description: sha256 of the conformed output; the replay proof.

skippedNoNumber.description: Products with no card number, not conformed.

conformant.description: Listings matched with no correction and no drift.

corrected.description: Listings matched after at least one rule fired.

descriptiveDrift.description: Listings matched but disagreeing with the official card on a printed stat.

driftWarnings.description: Drift on 3 or more fields; price kept but flagged.

pointsPriced.description: Cards that received a price point.

suspect.description: Price points flagged by the movement check.

promo-group.description: Corrections by rule promo-group. Promo group abbreviation rewritten to the official set code.

combo-base.description: Corrections by rule combo-base. priceSource changed from direct to combo for a card-plus-token listing.

group-set.description: Corrections by rule group-set. Group names a set directly; expansion set from it.

exclusive-set.description: Corrections by rule exclusive-set. Variant suffix names a different set than the group.

token-number.description: Corrections by rule token-number. Token listed as T<n> mapped to the same-titled token at that number.

title-drift.description: Corrections by rule title-drift. TCGplayer title typo within edit distance 2 of the official title.

number-shift.description: Corrections by rule number-shift. TCGplayer number one off; neighbour is the single exact match.

promo-number.description: Corrections by rule promo-number. Labelled promo listing up to 20 numbers from its printing.

verified-listing.description: Corrections by rule verified-listing. Hand-verified exception from the committed VERIFIED_LISTINGS table.

TcgPrinting.description: One tcg_printings row: one TCGplayer product matched to one official printing. See swu-card-data-fields.md, section TCG printing.

import_id.description: Import that produced the row; equals import.id.

card_id.description: Official serialCode of the matched printing; several products can share one.

product_id.description: TCGplayer product id; unique per row.

group_id.description: TCGplayer group id (roughly one per set or promo family).

price_normal.description: Non-foil market price in US dollars; null when none.

price_foil.description: Foil market price in US dollars; null when none.

price_source.description: direct is a single-card listing; combo is a card-plus-token listing.

combo_token_ref.description: Token(s) a combo listing includes, such as T04 or T03/T04; null for direct listings.

applied_rules.description: Correction rules applied to this listing, in run order; empty when none.

items.description: Committed correction rule id, in the order the rules run. promo-group: Promo group abbreviation rewritten to the official set code. combo-base: priceSource changed from direct to combo for a card-plus-token listing. group-set: Group names a set directly; expansion set from it. exclusive-set: Variant suffix names a different set than the group. token-number: Token listed as T<n> mapped to the same-titled token at that number. title-drift: TCGplayer title typo within edit distance 2 of the official title. number-shift: TCGplayer number one off; neighbour is the single exact match. promo-number: Labelled promo listing up to 20 numbers from its printing. verified-listing: Hand-verified exception from the committed VERIFIED_LISTINGS table.

drift.description: Where TCGplayer printed stats differ from the official card; null when there is no drift.

items.description: One field on which TCGplayer and the official list disagree.

tcg.description: TCGplayer value as text; null when TCGplayer lists none. Aspects are joined with a semicolon.

official.description: Official value as text; null when the card has none.

driftWarning.description: Set when drift touches 3 or more fields; null otherwise.

count.description: Number of drifted fields; equals fields.length.

PriceExport.description: tcgplayer-prices-rectified file: the import row plus its matched printings.

import.description: The price_imports row of this run.

printings.description: All tcg_printings rows of the import.

Correction.description: One tcg_corrections row: a committed rule rewriting one field of one TCGplayer listing. See swu-card-data-fields.md, section Correction.

seq.description: Position of this correction among the product's corrections.

rule_id.description: Committed correction rule id, in the order the rules run. promo-group: Promo group abbreviation rewritten to the official set code. combo-base: priceSource changed from direct to combo for a card-plus-token listing. group-set: Group names a set directly; expansion set from it. exclusive-set: Variant suffix names a different set than the group. token-number: Token listed as T<n> mapped to the same-titled token at that number. title-drift: TCGplayer title typo within edit distance 2 of the official title. number-shift: TCGplayer number one off; neighbour is the single exact match. promo-number: Labelled promo listing up to 20 numbers from its printing. verified-listing: Hand-verified exception from the committed VERIFIED_LISTINGS table.

CorrectionsFile.description: corrections file: tcg_corrections rows of one import.

Quarantine.description: One tcg_quarantine row: a TCGplayer listing that could not be matched safely and received no price. See swu-card-data-fields.md, section Quarantine.

product_name.description: TCGplayer listing title with its finish and tier suffixes.

number.description: TCGplayer card number text, such as 1125 or T01 // T02.

variant.description: Variant read from the listing suffix before quarantine; null when none could be read.

reason.description: Why the listing was quarantined. unparseable-number, unmapped-group, unknown-variant-suffix, no-candidate, field-disagreement, ambiguous, duplicate-claim.

candidate_card_ids.description: Official serialCodes the listing might have meant; often empty.

QuarantineFile.description: quarantine file: tcg_quarantine rows of one import.
